author: Francesco Mattana
title: Gnocchi with Pesto, Tuna and Roasted Tomatoes
ingredients: 200g sweet baby plum or small cherry tomatoes
30ml extra virgin olive oil, plus extra for drizzling
160g Rio Mare tuna in olive oil
instructions_list: Preheat the oven to 220C fan and roast the tomatoes with olive oil, sea salt and black pepper for 15 minutes or until soft and slightly charred.
To make the pesto, add the basil, garlic, pine nuts, cheese and olive oil to a blender and blitz until smooth. Taste it for seasoning and add a little salt if needed.
As soon as the tomatoes are ready, squeeze them gently to release their juices.

Cook the gnocchi in plenty of salted boiling water for around 2-3 minutes or as soon as they start to float in the water. Using a slotted spoon transfer them to a large bowl along with the roasted tomatoes and their juices.
Spoon in the pesto and mix it all together until nice and creamy. And if you need to you can add a little bit of pasta water to loosen the sauce.
Lightly break down the tuna fillets and stir them in as well. Serve up right away and enjoy!
description: This recipe is inspired by a beautiful pesto pasta with tuna that we make in Sardinia. It was born from leftovers and it's made by combining a bit of pesto, a bit of tomato sauce or tomatoes, preserved tuna and a few different shapes of pasta. The tuna is tender but firm so it gives texture to the dish and pairs beautifully with the flavours of the pesto and the sweetness from the tomatoes. Whether you make the gnocchi and the pesto or buy it already made for a quicker version, this is the perfect weeknight meal.
